responsibility: Implements the small out-of-line utility behavior for the analyzer’s symbol base class shared by regions and svalues. In practice this file supplies deterministic ID-based comparison so symbolic objects created by the region-model manager can be sorted reproducibly in dumps and other stable output without embedding that logic into every subclass.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the only out-of-line implementation for the symbol base class declared in symbol.h, namely the deterministic ID comparison helper used for stable ordering.
